items.scope: Palantir products and technologies only.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
Dragos products and third-party products it researches related to operational technology (OT)/industrial control systems (ICS) not covered by another CNA.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
AMD branded products and technologies only. AMD does not evaluate, remediate, or issue CVE IDs for vulnerabilities that only affect End-of-Life/End-of-Support products and technologies.
Siemens issues only.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.

Vulnerabilities that are discovered, validated, and coordinated through the Hackrate Ethical Hacking Platform, including: software, web applications, APIs, and cloud services; vulnerabilities validated and triaged by our internal security team; and findings disclosed under our coordination that are not in another CNA’s scope.
End of life open source projects supported by HeroDevs if hosted on HeroDevs.com, or issues in open source projects discovered by or reported to HeroDevs, unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Forcepoint products only.
Bosch products only.
Synology issues only.
Western Digital products including WD, SanDisk, SanDisk Professional, G-Technology, and HGST only.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
WordPress Plugins, Themes, and Core Vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, the Wordfence/Defiant team.
All Payara Platform product distributions (Payara Server, Micro, Embedded) for both Enterprise (commercial) and Community (OSS) distributions.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Dell, Dell EMC, and VCE issues only.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All HYPR products only.
openHarmony issues only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All ESET products only and vulnerabilities discovered by ESET that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.

All Ping Identity and ForgeRock products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Ping Identity or ForgeRock that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Acer issues only.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
All rami.io GmbH products and open source projects, including pretix, official pretix plugins and apps, and Venueless.
All Vaadin products and supported open source projects hosted at https://github.com/vaadin.
Elasticsearch, Kibana, Beats, Logstash, X-Pack, and Elastic Cloud Enterprise products only.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
Concrete CMS Core versions 8.5 and above.
Snowflake products, including those of its subsidiaries, and vulnerabilities in third-party software that are discovered by, or reported to, Snowflake that are not within another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in software, services, and infrastructure owned and managed by Spartans Security, and vulnerabilities researched and found by Spartans Security in third-party products that are not part of another CNA's scope.
All vulnerabilities on software products that our company provides, including KNIME Analytics Platform, KNIME Server, and KNIME Hub.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
All products and services developed and operated by FPT Software, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by FPT Software that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Fortra products and vulnerabilities discovered by Fortra in other products not covered by the scope of another CNA.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
All Netskope products and services.
Roche’s medical technology products.
Carrier Global products only.
Vulnerabilities discovered by Project Black that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
StrongDM issues only.
